fixes.what: Confidence 3 on a region the page does not give for 146 BC.

fixes.what: The note quoted a sentence that is not on the cited page, and the page does not date the Roman recovery of Syria.
fixes.why: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roman%E2%80%93Parthian_Wars has no 'held Syria for roughly two years' and no Gindarus. It says: 'After suffering a further defeat near the Syrian Gates, the Parthians withdrew from Syria' (undated) and 'They returned in 38 BC, but were decisively defeated by Ventidius and Pacorus was killed.' The year 38 is defensible, but the withdrawal may be 39.
fixes.fix: Replaced the note with the page's sentences and lowered confidence 3 to 2.

fixes.what: The note says Antony reaffirmed Cleopatra's Cyprus 'in 40'.
fixes.why: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roman_Cyprus: 'Antony reaffirmed that Cleopatra was ruler of Cyprus at the Donations of Alexandria.' That was 34, not 40.
fixes.fix: Changed to 'at the Donations of Alexandria (34)'.

fixes.what: The quoted sentence was a paraphrase, not the page text.
fixes.why: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bithynia_and_Pontus: 'In 74 BC, during the Third Mithridatic War, King Nicomedes IV of Bithynia died ... bequeathed his kingdom to Rome'; 'The Senate immediately voted to annex the kingdom as a province directly governed by the Republic.'

fixes.what: BLOCKING. The 146 BC gain uses the gazetteer region 'Africa Proconsularis'. That region is Tunisia plus Tripolitania plus Algeria's Constantine, Annaba, Skikda and Guelma provinces, so it gives Rome Cirta and Tripolitania in 146.
fixes.why: Africa page: the rest 'was left in the domain of ... Massinissa'. kingdom-of-numidia holds Lepcis and Tripolitania from 158 (its /ledger/2) and eastern Numidia until 46; RR's own /ledger/144 gains eastern Numidia only in 46. Region is gazetteer regions.jsonl 'Africa Proconsularis'.
fixes.fix: Replace the region with Carthage's last territory east of the fossa regia (Thabraca to Thaenae): northern and central-eastern Tunisia, as admin1 units or Cliopatria's Carthage -149 shape. Text: 'the Carthaginian territory annexed as the province of Africa, capital Utica'.

fixes.what: BLOCKING. The last correction runs the -36 shape 'to January 27 BC' without Cyprus and Cilicia Aspera. The ledger has no event for 31-27 beyond Thrace. The /ledger/156 note says 'Egypt (30) is the Empire's', yet the dossier itself ends in 27.
fixes.why: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roman_Cyprus: after Actium Octavian 'gained control of Egypt and Cyprus', 'Cyprus returns to Roman rule' (31 BC). Egypt was annexed in August 30, inside this dossier's life. Cliopatria's ptolemaic-kingdom_-30 shape runs to -28 and roman-empire_-27 is the first shape with Egypt.
fixes.fix: Pick one. (a) Add a new keyframe roman-republic_-31 (from -31 to -27) whose correction is the -36 shape plus Cyprus and Cilicia Aspera from 31/30 and Egypt from August 30, with matching ledger events (-31 or -30 gain ptolemaic-kingdom for Cyprus and Cilicia Aspera; -30 gain ptolemaic-kingdom for Egypt). (b) End the Roman land at -31 and hand over to roman-empire, saying so in successors.
